seoTitle: Embr — The Best Native Twitch Client for iPhone
metaDescription: Embr is a fast, native iPhone Twitch client with a premium liquid-glass design. Watch live, VODs, and clips with PiP and background audio, real-time chat with animated 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes, and full guest browsing. Free and open source.
heroHeadline: The Twitch client iPhone always deserved
heroSubhead: Embr is a fast, fully native Twitch client built in UIKit for iOS 18. Watch live, VODs, and clips in a real AVPlayer with picture-in-picture and background audio, and read chat in real time with animated emotes from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ merged into one stream.
highlights: Native AVPlayer with picture-in-picture and background audio
Real-time chat with 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes merged in
Browse everything as a guest — sign in only for Following
Open source, no tracking, your token stays in the Keychain

features.title: A real native player
features.body: Live streams, VODs, and clips play in AVPlayer, not a web wrapper. Picture-in-picture, background audio, quality selection, fullscreen, playback speed, latency control, and double-tap to seek — all the controls a native app should have.

features.title: Chat that keeps up
features.body: Real-time chat over Twitch EventSub with replies, badges, cheermotes, and emote autocomplete. Animated emotes from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ are merged into a single stream so messages render exactly as your community uses them.

features.title: Find something to watch
features.body: Browse live channels and top categories, search across the catalog, and open any stream in a tap. A dedicated Following tab keeps your channels close once you sign in.

features.title: Moderation built in
features.body: Report or block in a long-press, and pull up full moderator tools when you run a channel. Chat search and per-message actions keep busy rooms manageable.

features.title: Liquid glass, native feel
features.body: Programmatic UIKit with a premium liquid-glass design, symbol effects on live states, and the snappy, gesture-driven feel of an app built for the platform — not a port.

features.title: Yours to inspect
features.body: Embr is open source. Browse a stream as a guest with no account, or sign in with Twitch via OAuth when you want Following and chat. Your token lives in the Keychain only, and there is no tracking.

howItWorks.body: Open Embr and explore live channels, top categories, and search straight away — no account needed to watch.
Tap any stream for native AVPlayer playback with picture-in-picture, background audio, and real-time chat side by side.
Connect your Twitch account with OAuth to follow channels, chat with your emotes, and use moderator tools.

faq.a: No. Embr is an independent, third-party Twitch client. It is not made, endorsed, or affiliated with Twitch or Amazon. Twitch is a trademark of its owner.

faq.q: Do I need a Twitch account to use Embr?
faq.a: No. You can browse live channels, categories, search, and watch streams, VODs, and clips entirely as a guest. Sign in with Twitch only when you want a Following tab, to chat, or to use moderator tools.

faq.q: What can the video player do?
faq.a: Embr uses a native AVPlayer for live streams, VODs, and clips, with picture-in-picture, background audio, quality selection, fullscreen, playback speed, latency control, and double-tap to seek.
Chat runs over Twitch EventSub in real time and merges animated emotes from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ into one stream, alongside badges, cheermotes, replies, and emote autocomplete.

faq.q: Can I moderate my channel from Embr?
faq.a: Yes. Embr includes moderator tools, plus report and block actions on any message, and chat search to keep busy rooms manageable.
Yes. Embr does not track you. Sign-in uses Twitch's official OAuth, and your access token is stored only in the iOS Keychain on your device.
Yes — Embr is built in the open, and the full source is on GitHub at github.com/guitaripod/embr.

faq.q: Which devices does Embr run on?
faq.a: Embr runs on iPhone with iOS 18 and later.
